emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: Commander, we have read the letters Landower's messenger carried. The 'Battlemage' is no spell and no engine. It is a person: a war-sorcerer of the old world, sealed alive in a tomb in the mountains of Tilicia.

emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: Landower's ally there, Warden Hadrik Tolm, is digging that tomb out. If the old texts are true, whoever wakes the Battlemage commands it. Go to Tilicia. Reach the tomb before the Warden opens it.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Tilicia is all mountain, Varius, and Warden Tolm holds the one road wide enough for an army. We will need friends who know the others.

intro.speaker: Field Officer
intro.text: The village ahead belongs to Clan Ostrak, Commander. Their chief is one Maren Ostrak, and her people have no love for the Warden.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: His riders are on the valley road. If we mean to win these people, now is the hour.

victory.speaker: Chief Ostrak
victory.text: You bled for a village that is not yours. I did not expect that of the Empire.

victory.speaker: Chief Ostrak
victory.text: Take two bands of my Cragsmen. No wall in Tilicia was built to stop them.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: She says one fortress bars the road to the tomb: Frostgate. And that its builders never reckoned with men who climb.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The village is lost, Commander, and the clans with it.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Frostgate bars the last road to the tomb. The Warden has left it a strong garrison and gone on ahead.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Its builders trusted the mountain to guard the eastern side. Let us see whether they were right.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: Frostgate is ours, Commander. A handful of the Spellwardens have laid down their maces.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Men who can snuff out a Wizard's fire. The Warden has been preparing to face magic for some time. Or to keep some of his own on a leash.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: They say the Warden broke the last seal on the tomb two days ago, and that the mountain has not been quiet since.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: They are asking to march with us, Sir Anston. They would rather face what is in that tomb beside an army.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We broke on the gate, Commander. Frostgate still stands.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: The tomb, Varius, on the plateau above Frostgate. Warden Tolm has drawn up everything he has left before its doors.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Clansmen, Spellwardens, and they say the tomb's own sleepers answer him here. Mind your rear on that plateau.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: Commander, the tomb is open. The sarcophagus is gone. There are drag marks, and cart ruts leading down to the river.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Gone a week, by the look of it. The Warden was never guarding the Battlemage. He was guarding the road it left by.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The bargemen say the river runs to the sea, Sir Anston. And that a ship with purple sails was waiting at its mouth.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Purple sails. Isoluccia. One of the stone guardians knelt when the Warden fell, Varius. It seems to be yours now.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The Warden holds the plateau, Commander. We could not reach him.

emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: Commander, the tomb was empty because the sarcophagus had already gone down the river to the coast, and from there by ship to Isoluccia.

emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: Doge Aurelio Sant'Abra paid for all of it: Landower, Tolm, the digging. He means to rule the Empire through the Battlemage. The Emperor's fleet will carry your army to the islands, but his harbor is chained shut. Open it, take the city, and do not let him finish waking it.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: There it is, Varius. Isoluccia. Half a hundred islands, one very rich Doge, and a chain as thick as a man across his harbor mouth.

intro.speaker: Field Officer
intro.text: A sellsword captain rowed out to the fleet in the night, Commander. Bellaro, of the Free Company. He says his marines are done with the Doge.

intro.speaker: Captain Bellaro
intro.text: He woke something in the citadel that he cannot rule, and I do not fight beside a thing that does not sleep. No ship of yours will pass that chain. My men know the forts that hold it.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: A sellsword, but an honest one by all accounts. Then we open the harbor from the land, Captain, and your company sails with Carrone.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The fleet is in the harbor, Commander. Siege engines and fresh troops are landing.

victory.speaker: Captain Bellaro
victory.text: There is the signal. The Free Company sails with Carrone! Take two bands of my marines for your own, Commander. The sea is no wall to them.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: And the Doge's own crossbowmen are coming over to us with their shields. They can see how this ends.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The Arsenal is the next strongpoint. Whoever holds it holds the harbor.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The tide has turned, Commander. The fleet has stood back out to sea.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: The Doge will throw everything at the Arsenal, Varius. He knows what it means to lose it.

intro.speaker: Field Officer
intro.text: The shipwrights have stayed, Commander. They say they would rather mend our walls than his.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The Arsenal held, Commander.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Stone guardians in the streets of a merchant city. The Doge has stopped pretending.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: There is only the citadel left, Varius. And whatever he woke inside it.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The Arsenal is lost, Commander. The fleet is burning at its moorings.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: The citadel of Isoluccia. Everything Landower schemed for ends behind that gate.

intro.speaker: Field Officer
intro.text: The men are ready, Commander. They would follow you against the old world itself.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: They are about to.

victory.speaker: The Battlemage
victory.text: In a thousand years no commander has beaten me in the field. The old law is plain. I am yours to order.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: Commander, the Doge's banners are coming down all over the city.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Landower, Tolm, Sant'Abra. Three men who thought they could own it, and it outlived them all.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: It will march home with us, Varius. I only wonder what the Emperor will do with such a weapon.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The lightning... Commander, there is nothing left of the line.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: Commander Varius, the Doge is fallen but his fleet is not. Admiral Corvane has taken it out into the becalmed heart of Mare Nostra, where no wind has blown since spring, and no grain ship has reached Carrone in a month.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: He has filled his decks with the arena gladiators of the island cities. Captain Bellaro and his Free Company will sail with you. Find the Admiral, board him, and open my sea lanes.

intro.speaker: Captain Bellaro
intro.text: There she lies, Commander. One of Corvane's pickets, with a cutter in tow, and the sea like glass.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: No wind, no oars worth the name. A sea battle here is a land battle on planks. We know how to fight those.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The picket is ours, Commander, and the cutter with her.

victory.speaker: Captain Bellaro
victory.text: Her log says the Admiral is moving a convoy through the calm. Three hulls lashed together, low in the water.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Then that is where his fighters will be. And his silver.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: They have cut the grapples, Commander. We are adrift.

intro.speaker: Captain Bellaro
intro.text: The convoy, Commander. Corvane emptied the arenas of six cities to guard it.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Men who fight for a crowd fight to be seen. Give them nothing to play to.

victory.speaker: Arena Champion
victory.text: Well fought. We were sold to the Admiral by the season. The season is over.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: Commander, a good number of the arena men are asking for our colors.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Take them, Varius. I would sooner have that sword arm beside me than across a plank.

victory.speaker: Captain Bellaro
victory.text: And the convoy's master has talked. Corvane's flagship lies a day's drift to the east.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We never got off our own deck, Commander.

intro.speaker: Captain Bellaro
intro.text: The flagship, Commander, with an escort on each beam. He has nowhere to run without a wind.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Nor have we. Whoever holds these decks at sunset holds Mare Nostra.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The fleet has struck, Commander. The sea lanes are open.

victory.speaker: Captain Bellaro
victory.text: You will want to see the Admiral's chart room. He was not only starving the Empire.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Letters, Varius. Corvane was selling what the Doge learned from the Battlemage. Runes, rites, all of it.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: The buyer is a warlord in the isles of Satoshi, far to the east. It seems our voyage is not over.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The flagship has thrown us back, Commander. Our own deck is burning.

emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: Commander, the charts you took from Admiral Corvane mark a course to the far north-east, to the Isles of Satoshi. With them were copies of every scroll the Doge's scholars made about the Battlemage. Corvane was selling them.

emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: The buyer is a warlord of those isles, Lord Kagemori, who means to make a Battlemage of his own. A rival, Lord Ishiro, has sent to the Emperor for help. Sail to Satoshi. Those scrolls must not be used.

intro.speaker: Lord Ishiro
intro.text: I am Ishiro, lord of the eastern isle. Kagemori has burned three of my villages for refusing him the old shrines.

intro.speaker: Lord Ishiro
intro.text: Land at the paddy road and I will raise my banner beside yours. It is the only road to my hill.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The village is ours, Commander. The samurai would not give ground. Not one of them.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: I have not seen their like. Whatever Kagemori means to make of the Battlemage's secrets, he has the soldiers to make use of it.

victory.speaker: Lord Ishiro
victory.text: He knows you have landed. He will come for my hill before you can reach his castle. Come quickly.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We are driven back to the boats, Commander.

intro.speaker: Lord Ishiro
intro.text: My hill is a fence of logs and a hall, Commander. It has stood two hundred years because no lord of these isles would shame himself by burning it.

intro.speaker: Lord Ishiro
intro.text: Kagemori is no longer that kind of lord.

victory.speaker: Lord Ishiro
victory.text: My hill stands. I did not think to see this evening, Commander.

victory.speaker: Lord Ishiro
victory.text: Take two bands of my own samurai into your army. They asked it of me. They wish to be there when Kagemori's gate comes down.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: His castle lies across the strait, Varius, with the sea at its back. Corvane's scrolls are inside it.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The hill is lost, Commander, and Lord Ishiro with it.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Kagemori's castle, Varius. Stone walls, a moat fed from the sea, and every samurai he has left.

intro.speaker: Lord Ishiro
intro.text: My retainers will show your men the fords. After that it is swords.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The keep is on fire, Commander. Kagemori's priests put the torch to the scroll room before we reached it.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Let it burn, Varius. Tolm dug the Battlemage up, the Doge woke it, Corvane sold it, and Kagemori would have copied it. Every one of them is dead of it.

victory.speaker: Lord Ishiro
victory.text: The old shrines say a weapon that outlives its makers is a curse. Tonight the last of it is ash on the sea wind.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Then there is one Battlemage in the world, and it marches under your banner. See that it never needs a second. Let us go home.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We could not carry the moat, Commander. Kagemori still holds his castle.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: Commander Varius, you have given me back Mare Nostra, and I must ask for a second sea. The captains who would not strike with Admiral Corvane have gone north, to the Mirror Sea, and taken service with a pirate who calls himself Reaver-King Skarl.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: He burns the Rukiev fishing towns and sets beasts on those who run. There is no channel between the two seas. Your ships will be hauled over the Tilician hills. Find this king of reavers and end him.

intro.speaker: Field Officer
intro.text: The portage is behind us, Commander. Every hull we own came over the Tilician hills on rollers, and here is the Mirror Sea.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: And here are the reavers. Four ships roped stem to stern across the strait, like a boom. We go through them or we go home.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The line is broken, Commander. All four hulls are ours.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: There was a cage on the last one, Varius. Iron, man-high, and chewed from the inside. Whatever they kept in it, they took it with them.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: They have thrown us back across the plank, Commander. The strait is still shut.

intro.speaker: Field Officer
intro.text: We have found what was in the cage, Commander. A hulk with kennels the length of her deck, and she is coming alongside.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Skarl breeds them on the islands. He does not waste Marines on a boarding when a pack will do it for meat. Three planks, and they will come down all three.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The kennel ship is taken, Commander. The handlers' whips and whistles with her.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: There are whelps below, Varius, not yet blooded, and our militia are farm boys who grew up with dogs. Give me a season and a Medal to pin on the best of them, and the Empire will have Beast Masters of its own.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The pack has the deck, Commander. We cannot hold the planks.

intro.speaker: Field Officer
intro.text: Skarl's own anchorage, Commander. A spit of sand, a hall, and his flagship moored across the only approach.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Every reaver on the Mirror Sea answers to him and to nothing else. Take the man and the fleet is only boats.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The Reaver-King is fallen, Commander. His captains are rowing for the far shore.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: The Rukiev coast can fish again, Varius, and so can we. Two seas in one year. The Emperor will run out of water to send you to.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We never reached the sand, Commander. The flagship has thrown us back.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: Commander Varius, the Reaver-King is dead and his captains are not. They have run east from the Mirror Sea to a jungle coast the Rukiev call Tezcal, and they have found a patron there.

emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: A priest-king, Commander, the Sun-Speaker Itzcal. The reavers bought their welcome with a story: that the Emperor keeps a man who throws lightning. Itzcal has decided that such fire belongs to his god, and he is taking Rukiev fishermen for his altar until he gets it.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: I will not have a Battlemage bargained for by anyone, least of all by a man who has never seen one. Land at Tezcal. End the reavers, and persuade this priest that the sky is not his to collect.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: The jungle coast of Tezcal, Varius. Skarl's captains ran here when their king fell, and somebody ashore has given them a roof.

intro.speaker: Field Officer
intro.text: There is one road up from the beach. We march in column and we keep the scouts close.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The road is clear, Commander. The reavers are dead and the spotted men have gone back into the trees.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: They fought for a paymaster they called the Sun-Speaker. Reavers do not learn a word like that for nothing.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: Some of their dead carried our own pikes, Commander, cut short for the forest. The men want to try it.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We are cut to pieces on the road, Commander. Back to the boats.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: The Sun-Speaker's city lies beyond the river, Varius. He has posted his eagle order at the only crossing for thirty miles.

intro.speaker: Field Officer
intro.text: Our prisoners say the eagles and the priest are no friends. They hold the ford because he holds their families.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The far bank is ours, Commander. One of the eagle captains has laid his spear-thrower at your feet.

victory.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victory.text: I am Cuali. The Sun-Speaker Itzcal told us you carry a stolen sun, a man who throws the sky's own fire. He means to feed that man to the altar and take the fire for himself.

victory.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victory.text: He has fed it enough of my people already. Let me show your archers the atlatl. Then let me show you his temple.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: The Battlemage, Varius. The reavers sold him the story, and he believed all of it.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The river ran red and we never reached the bank, Commander.

intro.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
intro.text: The Temple of the Sun, Commander. One gate, a wall my own order built, and Itzcal on the altar stone at the heart of it.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: He wants the Battlemage on that stone, Varius. I should prefer to disappoint him in person.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The Sun-Speaker is dead, Commander. The temple guard have thrown down their clubs.

victory.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victory.text: My people will choose a quieter priest. The serpents are no man's servants, but one of them has followed your banner down the steps. I would not send it away.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Tolm, the Doge, Corvane, Kagemori, and now a priest who had never even seen it. The Battlemage has killed more men by rumour than by lightning, Varius.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: Let us go home before the rumour finds another shore.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We could not carry the gate, Commander. The altar is still burning.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: Commander Varius, the north is burning. Longships out of the mountain holds of Jarnheim have raided Hunewold and Rukiev three summers running, and this summer they did not go home.

emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: Their Jarl is a man named Haldor, Commander. The Hunewold say his dead fight for him and that a giant keeps his gate. I would call that a fireside tale, if the survivors did not all tell it the same way.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: A skald of theirs has come to my court to ask for an army, which tells you what his own people think of this Jarl. Take the pass, take the town, and bring me Haldor's oath or his axe.

intro.speaker: Eirik the Skald
intro.text: I am Eirik, Commander, a skald of the Holds, and I have sung for three Jarls. This one I will not sing for. Haldor burns farms that owe him nothing.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: The skald knows the road, Varius, and the road is the Raven Pass. Haldor's bear-shirts hold it.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The pass is ours, Commander. Not one of the bear-shirts ran.

victory.speaker: Eirik the Skald
victory.text: They never do. But some of your axemen watched how they fought, and they have been very quiet since. Give those men a bearskin and they will not be quiet long.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We cannot hold the road, Commander. The pass is theirs.

intro.speaker: Eirik the Skald
intro.text: Below the pass lies Jarnborg, the iron town. Its outer gate stands on the far bank of the river, and Haldor's shieldmaidens stand on the near one.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: A shield wall on a bridge, Varius. We go through it, or we get wet going round it.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The bridge is ours, Commander, and the gate behind it. The shield wall is broken.

victory.speaker: Eirik the Skald
victory.text: Three of them have asked to stand in your line instead. They say a wall should have something worth standing in front of.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: The dead men at the gate trouble me more, Varius. Somebody in that town is calling the Jarl's old warriors back out of the ground.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We could not break the wall, Commander. The bridge is still theirs.

intro.speaker: Eirik the Skald
intro.text: Jarnborg itself, Commander. One wall, one gate, the long houses inside it, and the Jarl's hall against the mountain.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Einherjar in the court and a frost giant at the gate, Varius. I have fought kings who kept worse company, but not many.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: Jarl Haldor is dead, Commander. The hird has laid down its axes, and the pale ones have simply stopped.

victory.speaker: Eirik the Skald
victory.text: Not all of them. One of the chosen has knelt to your banner. He says he was promised a fight worth leaving the hall for, and he has only now had it.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: The Holds will choose a new Jarl by spring, Varius. Let us see that the skald has a say in it.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The gate held, Commander. Jarnborg is still his.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: Commander Varius, the great river south-east of Sabbi Amar has been closed to every boat and caravan since the spring. The kingdom on its banks is called Khemret, and it has fed half the desert for a thousand years.

emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: It has no king, Commander. A High Priest of the dead named Nekhet rules it from a temple on the west bank, and he has decided that the living owe him their grain. The captain of his own desert scouts has ridden to us rather than serve him.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: Abbisin cannot eat sand, and I will not see what we won there starve. Take the road to the river, cross it, and open Nekhet's granaries. If the priest objects, weigh his heart for him.

intro.speaker: Captain Meryt
intro.text: I am Meryt, Commander. I led the Medjay of the east bank until the High Priest told us whom we might guard and whom we might not. The road to the river is this way.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Our guide says his old company holds the rocks ahead, Varius. He also says they shoot better than he does.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The road is ours, Commander. I can see the river from here, and green on both banks.

victory.speaker: Captain Meryt
victory.text: Some of the bowmen you spared were mine before they were Nekhet's. Put bows like theirs in the hands of your own marksmen and I will teach them the rest.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We are shot to pieces on the road, Commander. Back to the wells.

intro.speaker: Captain Meryt
intro.text: Everything Nekhet owns is on the west bank, Commander: the temples, the tombs, the granaries. Between us and it lies the river, and one causeway.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: He has put his best infantry on it, Varius. I would have done the same.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: We hold both ends of the causeway, Commander. The west bank is open.

victory.speaker: Captain Meryt
victory.text: The smiths of the river towns will forge a khopesh for any pikeman willing to learn it. Yours have just had the lesson from the wrong end.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: The prisoners will not look west, Varius. They say the High Priest keeps something in his temple that eats men who fail him.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We could not take the causeway, Commander. The river is still closed.

intro.speaker: Captain Meryt
intro.text: The House of the Dead, Commander. An avenue of standing stones, one gate, and Nekhet in the inner court before the tomb of the first kings.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: Priests who burn the wounded and beasts that eat them, Varius. He has built himself a very thorough court.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The High Priest is dead, Commander. The temple guard have put down their swords, and the beasts have gone back to the river.

victory.speaker: Captain Meryt
victory.text: One of the younger priests has asked to serve you. He says the fire is only a scale, and a scale does not care who holds it.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: The river is open and the granaries with it, Varius. Abbisin's caravans can come south again.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We could not carry the gate, Commander. The avenue is full of our dead.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: Commander Varius, the grain ships that round the western cape are not coming home. Their crews are being taken off the islands the charts call Moananui, where war canoes come out of the lagoons at dusk.

emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: The islanders are led by an elder named Matahi, Commander, a keeper of their spirits. The sailors who got away speak of men riding hawks, and of a serpent in the water that answers when he calls.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: A navigator of theirs has offered to pilot my fleet through the reefs. He asks only that the villages be left standing. Grant him that, and bring me an end to those canoes.

intro.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
intro.text: I am Kahu, Commander. I have steered canoes between these islands since I was a boy, and I will steer your ships to the one beach where Matahi's men cannot stop you in the surf.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: They can stop us on the sand instead, Varius. The navigator says the Toa will be waiting.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The beach is ours, Commander. The Toa have gone back into the palms.

victory.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
victory.text: Not all of them. Some stayed to look at men who can take that first thrust and stand. They would rather fight beside such men than against them.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: They have driven us back into the surf, Commander.

intro.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
intro.text: Matahi's village stands on the inner island, Commander, behind a reef that has drowned better armies than yours. I mean no insult. They were my cousins.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: A lagoon to wade and hawks overhead, Varius. I would rather storm a wall.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: We are across, Commander, and the far shore is ours.

victory.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
victory.text: One of the hawks has come down among your horse-boys and will not leave them. A hawk chooses its rider, Commander, not the other way. I would let it.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We cannot cross under those birds, Commander. The reef is theirs.

intro.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
intro.text: The Hill of Spirits, Commander. A fence of stakes, the meeting house, and Matahi himself. He is a tohunga, a keeper of the old words, and he is my mother's brother.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: And he has a sea-serpent in the lagoon at the foot of his hill, Varius, if the navigator is to be believed. After the hawks, I believe him.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The elder is dead, Commander. The Toa have grounded their spears, and the thing in the lagoon has gone back under.

victory.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
victory.text: The young keepers have asked to sail with you. They say the words should travel, now that the man who kept them here is gone.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: The islands will send the Emperor their canoes after this, Varius, and no reaver will ever find a harbour here again.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The hill has thrown us back, Commander. The fence still stands.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: Commander Varius, the hill villages east of Tilicia have stopped sending their tithe, and the men I sent to ask why have not come back. Their heads have, on a rack, by way of a trader.

emperorBrief.speaker: Archwizard Thaddius
emperorBrief.text: The highlands are called Coatlan, Commander, the place of serpents. An order of warriors rules there in the name of something they keep in a temple that is only opened at night. The lowland priests will not say its name.

emperorBrief.speaker: Emperor Sebatini
emperorBrief.text: An Eagle Captain of the jungle orders has offered to guide an army up the mountain. He says his people have paid that temple for long enough. Go up with him, and put out whatever is burning there.

intro.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
intro.text: I am Cuali, Commander, a captain of the eagle order of the jungle. My people serve the sun. Above us, in Coatlan, there is an older temple, and what it serves is not the sun.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: The Eagle Captain will guide us up, Varius. He says the road runs through a forest that belongs to men who dress as snakes.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The road is open, Commander. The snake-skins have gone back up the mountain.

victory.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victory.text: My jaguars watched them fight, and two have asked the order's leave to take the serpent's skin. I have given it. A man should know his enemy's poison.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: We cannot hold the road, Commander. The forest is full of them.

intro.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
intro.text: Beyond the forest the land opens on a lake as wide as a day's march, Commander. The serpent order drowned its prisoners there for the things that live in it.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: So the lake is on their side as well, Varius. I am beginning to miss the jungle.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: We hold both ends of the causeway, Commander. The lake has gone still.

victory.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victory.text: One of the water-dogs has followed your leech-keepers back to camp and is eating out of their hands. I cannot explain it. Perhaps it only wanted feeding.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: They have pulled the column apart, Commander. We are back on the near shore.

intro.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
intro.text: The Temple of Stars, Commander. It is only open at night, because the thing it houses cannot bear the sun. Every priest in the lowlands fears it, and pays it, and never speaks of it.

intro.speaker: War Advisor
intro.text: A demon behind a wall and a captain who has sworn never to step back, Varius. We go in after dark, and we do not stop at the gate.

victory.speaker: Field Officer
victory.text: The thing on the altar is gone, Commander. It went out like a lamp.

victory.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victory.text: The captain of the shorn ones lives, and he has cut his banner from its pole and laid it at your feet. He kept his oath. He never stepped back. Take him, Commander. There are few like him.

victory.speaker: War Advisor
victory.text: The hill villages will send their tithe again, Varius, and this time nobody will be sending heads back with it.

defeat.speaker: Field Officer
defeat.text: The gate held, Commander, and it is nearly dawn. We must fall back.

levels.name: Ostrak's Bargain
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Tolm's Wardens
levels.objectiveText: Defend the clan village from the Warden's men. At least three of the six Cragsmen bands must survive.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Defend the clan village from the Warden's men. At least three of the six Cragsmen bands must survive.

victoryLines.speaker: Chief Ostrak
victoryLines.text: You bled for a village that is not yours. I did not expect that of the Empire.

victoryLines.speaker: Chief Ostrak
victoryLines.text: Take two bands of my Cragsmen. No wall in Tilicia was built to stop them.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: She says one fortress bars the road to the tomb: Frostgate. And that its builders never reckoned with men who climb.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The village is lost, Commander, and the clans with it.

lines.speaker: Chief Ostrak
lines.text: So the Empire comes to my door. You climbed the Warden's road to do it, and his men are an hour behind you, Commander.

lines.speaker: Chief Ostrak
lines.text: Hadrik Tolm takes our sons to dig in his tomb and burns the roof of any clan that refuses. Stand with us today and Clan Ostrak stands with you after.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: A fair bargain. Keep the clansmen alive, Varius. We will want every one of them.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: More of them on the north road, Commander!

lines.speaker: Tilician Clansman
lines.text: The south gap! They are in the south gap!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: That is the last of the Warden's column. Break it and the village is safe.

lines.speaker: Chief Ostrak
lines.text: Enough. My clan is bleeding out for your Emperor. Go back down your road, Commander.

levels.name: Frostgate
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Frostgate Garrison
levels.objectiveText: Storm the fortress of Frostgate and destroy its garrison.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Storm the fortress of Frostgate and destroy its garrison.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Frostgate is ours, Commander. A handful of the Spellwardens have laid down their maces.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Men who can snuff out a Wizard's fire. The Warden has been preparing to face magic for some time. Or to keep some of his own on a leash.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: They say the Warden broke the last seal on the tomb two days ago, and that the mountain has not been quiet since.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: They are asking to march with us, Sir Anston. They would rather face what is in that tomb beside an army.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We broke on the gate, Commander. Frostgate still stands.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Frostgate, Commander. One gate, and Musketeers on the wall either side of it.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: That gate is a killing ground. But look east. The wall ends where the cliff begins.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: No soldier of ours can climb it. Ostrak's Cragsmen can, and the Warden's engines stand just behind.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: And mark the maces behind the gate. Spellwardens, the tomb's old keepers: no Wizard's fire touches a man who stands near one.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Horsemen on the east road, Commander! The Warden has sent riders back to relieve the fortress.

levels.name: The Empty Tomb
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Warden Tolm
levels.objectiveText: Defeat Warden Tolm before the tomb of the Battlemage.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Defeat Warden Tolm before the tomb of the Battlemage.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Commander, the tomb is open. The sarcophagus is gone. There are drag marks, and cart ruts leading down to the river.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Gone a week, by the look of it. The Warden was never guarding the Battlemage. He was guarding the road it left by.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The bargemen say the river runs to the sea, Sir Anston. And that a ship with purple sails was waiting at its mouth.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Purple sails. Isoluccia. One of the stone guardians knelt when the Warden fell, Varius. It seems to be yours now.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The Warden holds the plateau, Commander. We could not reach him.

lines.speaker: Warden Tolm
lines.text: So this is the Emperor's hound. You are late, Commander. Years late.

lines.speaker: Warden Tolm
lines.text: Do you know what the old kings paid to bury what lay here? I have dug it out with goatherds.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Sir Anston, the statues before the doors. The statues are moving!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Guardians of living stone, set there by whoever sealed the Battlemage in. Our Priests cannot mend what they break, and no charge will move them.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: He is playing for time, Varius. Take the Warden and this ends.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Cragsmen on the ledges behind us, Commander! The Warden kept some clans of his own.

lines.speaker: Warden Tolm
lines.text: Fools. Open it. Go on, open it and see what you have won.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The Warden is down, Commander. His men are throwing down their arms.

levels.name: Goat Track
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Supply Column
levels.objectiveText: Set an ambush along the track and destroy the Warden's supply column.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Set an ambush along the track and destroy the Warden's supply column.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The column is taken, Commander. The Warden's garrisons will go hungry.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They cut their way out of the trap, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The Warden's supplies come up this track, Commander. The column is due within the hour.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Then we shall be in the trees when it arrives. Let them come well into the cut before we spring it.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Outriders on the track, Commander. The column is behind them.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: That is the rearguard. The whole column is in the cut. Now, Varius.

levels.name: Quarry of Giants
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Stone Sentinels
levels.objectiveText: Destroy every stone guardian in the old quarry.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Destroy every stone guardian in the old quarry.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The quarry is quiet, Commander. Nothing in it is standing.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The great one is whole under the rubble, Varius, runes and all. The craftsmen think they can raise it again, for us.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We cannot stand against them in the open, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The clans call this the Quarry of Giants, Commander. They say the stone here was never cut by men.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: It was cut into soldiers. Sixteen of them, by my count, all of them awake, and one in the middle that the others were only practice for.

levels.name: Winter Stores
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Granary Guard
levels.objectiveText: Seize both of the Warden's granaries within fifteen turns.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Seize both of the Warden's granaries within fifteen turns.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The stores are ours, Commander. The clans will eat this winter and the Warden's men will not.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: There is smoke over the granaries, Commander. We were too slow.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Two granaries, Commander, one either side of that ridge. The Warden's winter stores.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The guard will burn them if we give them a day to think of it. Take both, and quickly.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Both granaries are in our hands, Commander. The guard is running for the hills.

levels.name: The Harbour Chain
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Doge's Guard
levels.objectiveText: Capture both chain towers within 20 turns: bring a unit to the well inside each tower fort.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Capture both chain towers within 20 turns: bring a unit to the well inside each tower fort.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The fleet is in the harbor, Commander. Siege engines and fresh troops are landing.

victoryLines.speaker: Captain Bellaro
victoryLines.text: There is the signal. The Free Company sails with Carrone! Take two bands of my marines for your own, Commander. The sea is no wall to them.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: And the Doge's own crossbowmen are coming over to us with their shields. They can see how this ends.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The Arsenal is the next strongpoint. Whoever holds it holds the harbor.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The tide has turned, Commander. The fleet has stood back out to sea.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Two towers, Commander, one on each shore, and the chain hangs between them.

lines.speaker: Captain Bellaro
lines.text: The windlass is by the well in each fort. Take both and the chain goes to the bottom.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The fleet cannot wait past the tide, Varius. The Captain's marines may wade the channel. Everyone else must choose a shore.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The chain is down, Commander! The fleet is coming in!

levels.name: The Arsenal
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Doge's Guard
levels.objectiveText: Hold the Arsenal for 12 turns.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The Arsenal held, Commander.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Stone guardians in the streets of a merchant city. The Doge has stopped pretending.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: There is only the citadel left, Varius. And whatever he woke inside it.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The Arsenal is lost, Commander. The fleet is burning at its moorings.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The Arsenal is ours, Commander, but the Doge wants it back before the fleet can unload.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Twelve turns, Varius. Hold these walls twelve turns and the harbor is ours for good.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The yard lies open to the sea on the north side. Watch the water. And let the shipwrights mend what the engines break.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The Doge's own marines on both shores, Commander! They are making for the slipway!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: A column at the west gate!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: More of them at the east gate, Commander!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Fresh troops from the south, and another engine with them.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Commander, the stone guardians! The ones from the tomb in Tilicia!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: So that is what came down the river with the sarcophagus. Steel yourselves, men. It is only stone.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: They are throwing in everything they have left, Commander!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The fleet is unloaded, Commander! The Doge's men are falling back to the citadel!

levels.name: Reign of the Battlemage
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Doge's Guard
levels.objectiveText: Storm the citadel and defeat the Battlemage.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Storm the citadel and defeat the Battlemage.

victoryLines.speaker: The Battlemage
victoryLines.text: In a thousand years no commander has beaten me in the field. The old law is plain. I am yours to order.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Commander, the Doge's banners are coming down all over the city.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Landower, Tolm, Sant'Abra. Three men who thought they could own it, and it outlived them all.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: It will march home with us, Varius. I only wonder what the Emperor will do with such a weapon.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The lightning... Commander, there is nothing left of the line.

lines.speaker: Doge Sant'Abra
lines.text: Commander Varius. You are in time to kneel. The Battlemage is awake, and it answers to me.

lines.speaker: The Battlemage
lines.text: I answer to the one who commands the field. I have not yet seen who that is.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Its lightning leaps from man to man, Varius. Do not pack the ranks. And keep the Tilician wardens near. Their runes are proof against it.

lines.speaker: Doge Sant'Abra
lines.text: Strike them down! I woke you! I command you!

lines.speaker: The Battlemage
lines.text: You paid for an army. You never led one. I serve no merchant.

lines.speaker: The Battlemage
lines.text: Enough. The field is yours, Commander. So, by the old law, am I.

levels.name: Smugglers' Cove
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Smugglers
levels.objectiveText: Clear the cove. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Clear the cove. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The cove is clear, Commander, and the silver is ours.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They were in the dunes all along, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Smugglers, Commander. They have been running the Doge's silver out through this cove.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Mind the dunes and the shallows both. Men who hide for a living are good at it.

levels.name: Lighthouse Rock
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Doge's Guard
levels.objectiveText: Hold the lighthouse for 10 turns.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The lighthouse held, Commander.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The light is out, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The light is lit, Commander. The fleet can find the channel as long as it burns.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: One causeway for their heavy troops. But marines will come over the rocks from every side. Ten turns, Varius.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Marines in the water to the north!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: More of them from the west!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: They are coming from every side at once, Commander!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The last ship is through the channel, Commander. They are pulling back.

levels.name: Pavise Row
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Doge's Guard
levels.objectiveText: Break the shield line in the market square. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Break the shield line in the market square. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The square is ours, Commander. That was a line worth breaking.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We never reached their shields, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The guild crossbowmen have drawn up across the market, Commander. Shield to shield.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: No cover between us and them, and our arrows will only do half their work. This one is won by hand.

levels.name: Grapples Away
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Corvane's Fleet
levels.objectiveText: Board the picket ship and its cutter. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Board the picket ship and its cutter. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The picket is ours, Commander, and the cutter with her.

victoryLines.speaker: Captain Bellaro
victoryLines.text: Her log says the Admiral is moving a convoy through the calm. Three hulls lashed together, low in the water.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Then that is where his fighters will be. And his silver.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They have cut the grapples, Commander. We are adrift.

lines.speaker: Captain Bellaro
lines.text: Grapples are fast, Commander. Two planks across, and not a breath of wind to part us.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Those are no sailors on her deck. Net and trident, sword and buckler. Arena men.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Gladiators, Varius. Crowd one and his blade finds every man around him. Come at them one rank at a time.

levels.name: The Lashed Convoy
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Corvane's Fleet
levels.objectiveText: Take the three lashed hulls of the convoy. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Take the three lashed hulls of the convoy. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Arena Champion
victoryLines.text: Well fought. We were sold to the Admiral by the season. The season is over.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Commander, a good number of the arena men are asking for our colors.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Take them, Varius. I would sooner have that sword arm beside me than across a plank.

victoryLines.speaker: Captain Bellaro
victoryLines.text: And the convoy's master has talked. Corvane's flagship lies a day's drift to the east.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We never got off our own deck, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Three hulls lashed beam to beam, Commander, and planks between them like streets.

lines.speaker: Arena Champion
lines.text: Come aboard, soldiers of the Empire. The sand is wet today, but the crowd is the same.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Two planks lead from our deck, Varius. Whatever crosses them fights alone until the next man is over. Let Bellaro's marines take the long way round.

levels.name: The Admiral's Deck
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Corvane's Fleet
levels.objectiveText: Board the flagship and defeat Admiral Corvane.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Board the flagship and defeat Admiral Corvane.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The fleet has struck, Commander. The sea lanes are open.

victoryLines.speaker: Captain Bellaro
victoryLines.text: You will want to see the Admiral's chart room. He was not only starving the Empire.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Letters, Varius. Corvane was selling what the Doge learned from the Battlemage. Runes, rites, all of it.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The buyer is a warlord in the isles of Satoshi, far to the east. It seems our voyage is not over.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The flagship has thrown us back, Commander. Our own deck is burning.

lines.speaker: Admiral Corvane
lines.text: Commander Varius. You have come a long way to drown. The Doge is dead, but his fleet is mine, and the sea lanes with it.

lines.speaker: Captain Bellaro
lines.text: His escorts lie either side of us, Commander. Planks to both, and two more straight onto the flagship.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Four ways across and none of them wide. The Admiral stands at the stern. Take him and the fleet strikes its colors.

lines.speaker: Admiral Corvane
lines.text: Strike... strike the colors. The calm has beaten me, not you.

levels.name: Blockade Runner
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Corvane's Fleet
levels.objectiveText: Hold your deck for 8 turns against the boarders.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Hold your deck for 8 turns against the boarders.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: We ran the blockade, Commander. The grain ships can follow.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They have the deck, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Two galleys alongside, Commander, one on each beam. They have us grappled.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The current will carry us past the blockade in eight turns. Hold the deck until then, Varius. Watch the planks, and watch the water.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Marines over the side to the north!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: More arena men on the north galley, Commander!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We are through the blockade, Commander! They are cutting their own grapples!

levels.name: Prize Convoy
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Corvane's Fleet
levels.objectiveText: Take both prize hulls. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Take both prize hulls. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Both prizes are ours, Commander. The cargo is Imperial grain. It can go home.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We are driven back to our own deck, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Two prizes under tow, Commander, and prize crews of arena men aboard both.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: One plank to each hull. Split the army or take them in turn, Varius, but mind the swimmers.

levels.name: The Paddy Road
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Kagemori's Host
levels.objectiveText: Land on Satoshi and clear Lord Kagemori's men from the road inland.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Land on Satoshi and clear Lord Kagemori's men from the road inland.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The village is ours, Commander. The samurai would not give ground. Not one of them.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: I have not seen their like. Whatever Kagemori means to make of the Battlemage's secrets, he has the soldiers to make use of it.

victoryLines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
victoryLines.text: He knows you have landed. He will come for my hill before you can reach his castle. Come quickly.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We are driven back to the boats, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We are ashore, Commander. One road runs inland, on a dyke between flooded fields.

lines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
lines.text: Those are Kagemori's samurai at the village gate. Do not judge them by their number, Commander.

lines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
lines.text: Men who stand near them fight harder, and men who face them lose heart. Break them first, or break nothing.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Then we keep our line off those paddies, Varius. A soldier knee deep in water is half a soldier.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: More banners on the north road, Commander. Kagemori has sent a second company down from the hills.

levels.name: Ishiro's Hill
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Kagemori's Host
levels.objectiveText: Hold Lord Ishiro's hill fort for ten turns. Lord Ishiro must survive.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Hold Lord Ishiro's hill fort for ten turns. Lord Ishiro must survive.

victoryLines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
victoryLines.text: My hill stands. I did not think to see this evening, Commander.

victoryLines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
victoryLines.text: Take two bands of my own samurai into your army. They asked it of me. They wish to be there when Kagemori's gate comes down.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: His castle lies across the strait, Varius, with the sea at its back. Corvane's scrolls are inside it.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The hill is lost, Commander, and Lord Ishiro with it.

lines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
lines.text: You honour my house, Commander. My retainers hold the gates. There are not enough of them.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Banners on the north road, and dust to the east and west. Kagemori has brought his whole host.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: If Lord Ishiro falls the island falls with him, Varius. Get our line inside that palisade.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: They are on the east road, Commander!

lines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
lines.text: The west gate. He means to come at us from every side at once.

lines.speaker: Lord Kagemori
lines.text: Ishiro! You have sold our islands to a foreign emperor. Open your gate and die as a lord should.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: They are pulling back, Commander. Kagemori's horn is sounding the retreat.

lines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
lines.text: He has spent his best men against my fence. Now his castle stands half empty.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Lord Ishiro is down, Commander. His retainers are laying their swords beside him.

levels.name: The Castle of Lord Kagemori
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Kagemori's Host
levels.objectiveText: Storm the castle and defeat Lord Kagemori.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Storm the castle and defeat Lord Kagemori.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The keep is on fire, Commander. Kagemori's priests put the torch to the scroll room before we reached it.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Let it burn, Varius. Tolm dug the Battlemage up, the Doge woke it, Corvane sold it, and Kagemori would have copied it. Every one of them is dead of it.

victoryLines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
victoryLines.text: The old shrines say a weapon that outlives its makers is a curse. Tonight the last of it is ash on the sea wind.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Then there is one Battlemage in the world, and it marches under your banner. See that it never needs a second. Let us go home.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We could not carry the moat, Commander. Kagemori still holds his castle.

lines.speaker: Lord Kagemori
lines.text: So the Emperor's hound has crossed the whole world to bark at my gate.

lines.speaker: Lord Kagemori
lines.text: Corvane sold me the making of a Battlemage. In a year I would have had ten. You will not give me the year, I think.

lines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
lines.text: The moat has three fords, Commander. His samurai will be standing in every one of them.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Kagemori is the keystone, Varius. Bring him down and the scrolls are ours.

lines.speaker: Lord Kagemori
lines.text: Burn them. Burn the scrolls. If I cannot have them, no one...

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Lord Kagemori has fallen, Commander. His samurai are kneeling.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Riders and samurai on the dyke road behind us, Commander, from both ends!

lines.speaker: Lord Kagemori
lines.text: Every man of these isles who can ride is coming to my horn, Emperor's hound.

levels.name: The Shrine Pass
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Shrine Guard
levels.objectiveText: Reach the mountain shrine within fourteen turns, before Kagemori's men carry off its relics.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Reach the mountain shrine within fourteen turns, before Kagemori's men carry off its relics.

victoryLines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
victoryLines.text: You have kept faith with gods that are not your own, Commander. It will be remembered.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The shrine is stripped bare, Commander. We came too late.

lines.speaker: Lord Ishiro
lines.text: The shrine above this pass keeps the oldest relics of my people. Kagemori's men are packing them onto mules.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: One road, one ford, and a wall of samurai at the top of it. We have until they finish loading, Varius.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We hold the shrine, Commander. The relics are still on the altar.

levels.name: The Pirate Stockade
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Coast Pirates
levels.objectiveText: Destroy the pirates in Kagemori's pay and burn out their stockade.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Destroy the pirates in Kagemori's pay and burn out their stockade.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The stockade is burning, Commander. Kagemori will get no more ships from this coast.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They held their fence, Commander. We will have to come again.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: A stockade on the shore, Commander. These are the pirates who carry Kagemori's silver and Corvane's letters.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Masterless samurai among them, by the look of it. Hired swords fight until the pay runs out. Let us end the pay.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: A boat on the beach behind us, Commander! More of them are wading ashore.

levels.name: The Line of Hulls
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Skarl's Reavers
levels.objectiveText: Fight from hull to hull along the reaver line. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Fight from hull to hull along the reaver line. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The line is broken, Commander. All four hulls are ours.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: There was a cage on the last one, Varius. Iron, man-high, and chewed from the inside. Whatever they kept in it, they took it with them.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They have thrown us back across the plank, Commander. The strait is still shut.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Four hulls moored in a ring, Commander, and we hold only this one. The next lies across that plank.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: One plank on to each, and no way back but the way we came. Take them in turn, Varius. Their last ship lies under our own stern, and her Marines will not wait for us to walk round.

levels.name: The Kennel Ship
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Skarl's Reavers
levels.objectiveText: Board the kennel ship. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Board the kennel ship. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The kennel ship is taken, Commander. The handlers' whips and whistles with her.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: There are whelps below, Varius, not yet blooded, and our militia are farm boys who grew up with dogs. Give me a season and a Medal to pin on the best of them, and the Empire will have Beast Masters of its own.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The pack has the deck, Commander. We cannot hold the planks.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Dogs, Commander! Big as ponies, and loose on her deck!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: War hounds, and the men with the whips are their Beast Masters. Each keeps a pair at heel and whistles up another when one falls. Kill the handler, Varius, and the kennel stays shut.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Both handlers are down, Commander! The hounds have no one to answer to.

levels.name: The Reaver-King
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Skarl's Reavers
levels.objectiveText: Cross the flagship to the islet and defeat Reaver-King Skarl.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Cross the flagship to the islet and defeat Reaver-King Skarl.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The Reaver-King is fallen, Commander. His captains are rowing for the far shore.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The Rukiev coast can fish again, Varius, and so can we. Two seas in one year. The Emperor will run out of water to send you to.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We never reached the sand, Commander. The flagship has thrown us back.

lines.speaker: Reaver-King Skarl
lines.text: So the Emperor carries his boats over mountains now. You should have left them there, Commander. My dogs have not eaten since the kennel ship.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: His flagship lies between us and that islet, Commander. Two planks up to her deck, and one off her bow to the sand.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The shallows round the islet will bear a man, Varius, but slowly. Skarl stands by his hall. When he falls, this sea is quiet again.

lines.speaker: Reaver-King Skarl
lines.text: Call them off... The sea was mine before your Empire had a name. It will be someone's after.

levels.name: The Fire Ship
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Skarl's Reavers
levels.objectiveText: Reach the fire ship's tiller before turn 13, or eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Reach the fire ship's tiller before turn 13, or eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The fire ship is aground and burning alone, Commander.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The grain fleet is burning, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: She is packed to the rail with pitch, Commander, and drifting down on the grain fleet!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Her crew mean to light her and swim. Get one man to the tiller behind her cabin, Varius, and we can put her on the rocks instead.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We have the tiller, Commander! She is turning for the rocks.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: She is alight, Commander, and among the grain ships.

levels.name: Wolf Pack
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Skarl's Reavers
levels.objectiveText: Three reaver cutters have you grappled. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Three reaver cutters have you grappled. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: All three cutters are ours, Commander. The pack is broken.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They are over the rail on every side, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Cutters, Commander! Two on the bow and one astern, and hounds on every one of them!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: They hunt as the dogs do, Varius. Three planks, three packs. Hold two and break the third.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: More of them up from below, Commander!

levels.name: The Green Road
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Host of the Sun
levels.objectiveText: Break the ambush on the jungle road. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Break the ambush on the jungle road. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The road is clear, Commander. The reavers are dead and the spotted men have gone back into the trees.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: They fought for a paymaster they called the Sun-Speaker. Reavers do not learn a word like that for nothing.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Some of their dead carried our own pikes, Commander, cut short for the forest. The men want to try it.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We are cut to pieces on the road, Commander. Back to the boats.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: One road inland, Commander, and trees to either side so thick a man cannot see his own shield arm.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Those are Skarl's runaway captains at the barricade. They did not build it alone, Varius.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Movement in the trees! Men in spotted hides, and they are running through that tangle as if it were a parade ground!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Jaguar warriors. Keep our line on the road and in the clearings. In the woods they are worth two of us.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: They are behind us, Commander! Out of the trees on both sides of the road!

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: The Sun-Speaker pays in gold for every heart, Carrone! Yours will buy me a new ship.

levels.name: The Serpent Ford
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Host of the Sun
levels.objectiveText: Force the river and clear the far bank. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Force the river and clear the far bank. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The far bank is ours, Commander. One of the eagle captains has laid his spear-thrower at your feet.

victoryLines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victoryLines.text: I am Cuali. The Sun-Speaker Itzcal told us you carry a stolen sun, a man who throws the sky's own fire. He means to feed that man to the altar and take the fire for himself.

victoryLines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victoryLines.text: He has fed it enough of my people already. Let me show your archers the atlatl. Then let me show you his temple.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The Battlemage, Varius. The reavers sold him the story, and he believed all of it.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The river ran red and we never reached the bank, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The river, Commander. A plank bridge on the road and a ford on either hand, waist deep.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Men in eagle feathers in the trees on the far bank. Dart-throwers. They will not need to see us to hit us.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Commander, above the water... By the Emperor, they have wings. Serpents with wings!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: They throw a wind and are gone before a bow can answer, Varius. Do not chase them. Take the bank and they have nowhere to rest.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: More of them on the north road, Commander, and another of those serpents over the trees.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Jaguar men on our own bank, Commander! They swam the river above the fords!

levels.name: The Temple of the Sun
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Host of the Sun
levels.objectiveText: Storm the temple and defeat Sun-Speaker Itzcal.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Storm the temple and defeat Sun-Speaker Itzcal.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The Sun-Speaker is dead, Commander. The temple guard have thrown down their clubs.

victoryLines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victoryLines.text: My people will choose a quieter priest. The serpents are no man's servants, but one of them has followed your banner down the steps. I would not send it away.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Tolm, the Doge, Corvane, Kagemori, and now a priest who had never even seen it. The Battlemage has killed more men by rumour than by lightning, Varius.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Let us go home before the rumour finds another shore.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We could not carry the gate, Commander. The altar is still burning.

lines.speaker: Sun-Speaker Itzcal
lines.text: So the thieves of the sun have come to my steps. Good. I was going to send for you.

lines.speaker: Sun-Speaker Itzcal
lines.text: You keep a man who throws the sky's fire. Fire belongs to the Sun, and the Sun speaks through me. Give him to the altar and you may sail home.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: He will blind your best soldiers and burn them one at a time, Commander, and mend his guard while he does it. He must die first or last. Not in between.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The Speaker is the keystone, Varius. His jaguars hold the court and his eagles the wall. Cuali's people will take the woods with us.

lines.speaker: Sun-Speaker Itzcal
lines.text: The Sun... does not... set...

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: It has set on you, Speaker. Jaguars! Eagles! The altar is cold. Put down your clubs.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Jaguar men in the trees behind us, Commander!

lines.speaker: Sun-Speaker Itzcal
lines.text: Come down, children of the wind! Carry these thieves up to me!

levels.name: The Night Hunt
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Jaguar Order
levels.objectiveText: Hold your camp in the clearing for 8 turns against the jaguar hunt.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Hold your camp in the clearing for 8 turns against the jaguar hunt.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Dawn, Commander. The fence held, and there are spotted hides all round it.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They are inside the fence, Commander. The camp is lost.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We camp in the clearing tonight, Commander. Fence on four sides and a fire in the middle.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: The jaguar order hunts at night, and it hunts camps. They will come through the trees from every side until the moon is down.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Eight turns of the glass, Varius. Keep the men inside the fence and let the forest come to us.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Eyes in the trees, Commander. North-west and south-east!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: They are coming over the south fence, Commander!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The whole order is out there, Commander. I can hear them calling to each other.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: The moon is down. The hunt is over, Commander. They will not come again tonight.

levels.name: The Sun Treasury
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Treasury Guard
levels.objectiveText: Reach the temple treasury within fourteen turns, or eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Reach the temple treasury within fourteen turns, or eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victoryLines.text: Forty towns will eat this winter, Commander. They will know whose soldiers carried it back.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The vault is empty, Commander. They got it away into the hills.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: Itzcal kept the tribute of forty towns in that vault, Commander. His under-priests are loading it onto litters for the hills.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: A priest of the sun inside, eagles on the wall, jaguars in the trees. We have until the litters are full, Varius.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We have the vault, Commander. The gold is still on the floor.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: A serpent over the trees behind us, Commander, and more of the spotted men under it!

levels.name: The Raven Pass
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Jarl Haldor's Hird
levels.objectiveText: Force the pass into Jarnheim. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Force the pass into Jarnheim. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The pass is ours, Commander. Not one of the bear-shirts ran.

victoryLines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
victoryLines.text: They never do. But some of your axemen watched how they fought, and they have been very quiet since. Give those men a bearskin and they will not be quiet long.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We cannot hold the road, Commander. The pass is theirs.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The Raven Pass, Commander. One road, a barricade across it, and rock on both sides too steep for a goat.

lines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
lines.text: Those are Haldor's bear-shirts in front of the barricade. They wear no mail and carry no shield, and they do not need to.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Berserkers, Varius. Wound one and it only hits harder. Put each of them down in a single turn, or do not touch it at all.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Bear-shirts in the gullies, Commander! They have come down the rock behind our line!

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: The Jarl sends his greeting, southerner, and his axes with it!

levels.name: The Shield Bridge
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Jarl Haldor's Hird
levels.objectiveText: Break the shield wall at the river gate. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Break the shield wall at the river gate. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The bridge is ours, Commander, and the gate behind it. The shield wall is broken.

victoryLines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
victoryLines.text: Three of them have asked to stand in your line instead. They say a wall should have something worth standing in front of.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The dead men at the gate trouble me more, Varius. Somebody in that town is calling the Jarl's old warriors back out of the ground.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We could not break the wall, Commander. The bridge is still theirs.

lines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
lines.text: Jarnborg, Commander. The river runs round the town like a ditch, and there is one bridge.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: And a wall of shields across it. Women, by their hair. They have not moved since sunrise.

lines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
lines.text: Shieldmaidens. Each one covers the fighter beside her, so a line of them is harder than the sum of it. Break the line and they are only soldiers.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: There are fords up and down the river, Varius. Slow going, but they come out behind that wall.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Bear-shirts at the fords, Commander! They are wading over to take us in the flank!

lines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
lines.text: The gate is opening. Look at their faces, Commander. Those men were buried years ago. I sang at two of the graves.

levels.name: The Jarl's Hold
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Jarl Haldor's Hird
levels.objectiveText: Storm Jarnborg and defeat Jarl Haldor.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Storm Jarnborg and defeat Jarl Haldor.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Jarl Haldor is dead, Commander. The hird has laid down its axes, and the pale ones have simply stopped.

victoryLines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
