victoryLines.text: Not all of them. One of the chosen has knelt to your banner. He says he was promised a fight worth leaving the hall for, and he has only now had it.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The Holds will choose a new Jarl by spring, Varius. Let us see that the skald has a say in it.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The gate held, Commander. Jarnborg is still his.

lines.speaker: Jarl Haldor
lines.text: So the Emperor has sent a clerk with a sword to collect for some burnt barns.

lines.speaker: Jarl Haldor
lines.text: Look behind me, clerk. My fathers' hirdmen have come back from the hall of the slain to drink with me, and a son of the old frost stands at my gate. What have you brought?

lines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
lines.text: The dead ones mend themselves on every man they kill, Commander. Do not feed them your wounded. And where the giant's club lands, men move like old women for a while.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The Jarl is the keystone, Varius. When he falls, the dead have nobody left to drink with.

lines.speaker: Jarl Haldor
lines.text: A clerk... Sing it kindly, skald...

lines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
lines.text: I will sing it truly, Haldor. Hird of Jarnborg! Your Jarl is dead and your dead are tired. Let them sleep.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Bear-shirts out of the woods on both flanks, Commander!

lines.speaker: Jarl Haldor
lines.text: Up, old friends! There is one more night's work in you yet!

levels.name: The Mead Hall
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Bear-shirt Lodge
levels.objectiveText: Take the mead hall before the hunting party returns. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Take the mead hall before the hunting party returns. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
victoryLines.text: No more feasts on other men's cattle. The valley farms will send you a barrel for this, Commander.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They have thrown us back from the palisade, Commander.

lines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
lines.text: The lodge of the bear-shirts, Commander. They feast here between raids, and half of them are out hunting.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: A palisade a man can climb and a gate two shieldmaidens can hold. Be inside before the hunters come home, Varius.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Horns in the high woods, Commander. The hunting party is back!

levels.name: The Giants' Stair
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Sons of the Frost
levels.objectiveText: Hunt down the frost giants on the high rocks. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Hunt down the frost giants on the high rocks. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
victoryLines.text: Four giants in a morning. I shall need a longer metre, Commander.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The giants have broken us, Commander. We are falling back down the stair.

lines.speaker: Eirik the Skald
lines.text: The Giants' Stair, Commander. Haldor fed the sons of the frost on stolen cattle, and now that the cattle have stopped they are coming down for the farms.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Three of them, and their thralls. A giant's club slows whatever it does not kill, Varius. Do not let them catch the line bunched.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Another one on the top stair, Commander, and bigger than the rest!

levels.name: The Red Road
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Host of the West Bank
levels.objectiveText: Clear the desert road to the river. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Clear the desert road to the river. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The road is ours, Commander. I can see the river from here, and green on both banks.

victoryLines.speaker: Captain Meryt
victoryLines.text: Some of the bowmen you spared were mine before they were Nekhet's. Put bows like theirs in the hands of your own marksmen and I will teach them the rest.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We are shot to pieces on the road, Commander. Back to the wells.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The Red Road, Commander. Sand, thorn and broken rock from here to the river, and a barricade where the road narrows.

lines.speaker: Captain Meryt
lines.text: Medjay in the rocks, Commander. My own people, once. Their bows carry further than yours, and the ground that trips your men does not trip them.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Then we do not stand and trade arrows, Varius. Close with them, and keep the horse back for their riders.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Riders out of the dunes on both flanks, Commander, and bowmen running beside them!

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: The river is closed, northerner. The High Priest has weighed your Emperor and found him light.

levels.name: The River Gate
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Host of the West Bank
levels.objectiveText: Force the causeway and clear the west bank. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Force the causeway and clear the west bank. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: We hold both ends of the causeway, Commander. The west bank is open.

victoryLines.speaker: Captain Meryt
victoryLines.text: The smiths of the river towns will forge a khopesh for any pikeman willing to learn it. Yours have just had the lesson from the wrong end.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The prisoners will not look west, Varius. They say the High Priest keeps something in his temple that eats men who fail him.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We could not take the causeway, Commander. The river is still closed.

lines.speaker: Captain Meryt
lines.text: The River Gate, Commander. A stone causeway laid by kings nobody remembers, and the only dry crossing in ten days' march.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Shields and sickle-swords from bank to bank. They look like a line that has held this place before.

lines.speaker: Captain Meryt
lines.text: Khopesh men. That hooked blade pulls a shield out of the way, so do not trust yours. There are shallows above and below the causeway, if your men do not mind the crocodiles.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: More of them coming down to the causeway from the temple road, Commander!

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: Chariot horse to the fords! Ride them down in the water!

levels.name: The House of the Dead
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Host of the West Bank
levels.objectiveText: Storm the tomb-temple and defeat High Priest Nekhet.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Storm the tomb-temple and defeat High Priest Nekhet.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The High Priest is dead, Commander. The temple guard have put down their swords, and the beasts have gone back to the river.

victoryLines.speaker: Captain Meryt
victoryLines.text: One of the younger priests has asked to serve you. He says the fire is only a scale, and a scale does not care who holds it.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The river is open and the granaries with it, Varius. Abbisin's caravans can come south again.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We could not carry the gate, Commander. The avenue is full of our dead.

lines.speaker: High Priest Nekhet
lines.text: You have crossed my river, soldier of the north. No living army has done that in my lifetime.

lines.speaker: High Priest Nekhet
lines.text: So you shall be judged as the dead are judged. My fire weighs the heart. What it finds wanting, the Devourer takes.

lines.speaker: Captain Meryt
lines.text: Do not send hurt men against the priests, Commander. That violet fire bites deepest where a man is already bleeding. And the beasts swallow whatever is nearly finished.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Fresh troops to the front and the wounded well back, Varius. Nekhet is the keystone. When he falls, his temple has no one left to judge for.

lines.speaker: High Priest Nekhet
lines.text: My own heart... on the scale... It is... heavy...

lines.speaker: Captain Meryt
lines.text: Guards of the west bank! The scale has spoken, and it has spoken against him. Open the granaries.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Beasts behind us, Commander! They came up out of the sand itself!

lines.speaker: High Priest Nekhet
lines.text: Come, guardians of the avenue. Let none of them leave it.

levels.name: The Oasis Caravan
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Caravan Guard
levels.objectiveText: Reach the caravan master's tents within fourteen turns, or eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Reach the caravan master's tents within fourteen turns, or eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Captain Meryt
victoryLines.text: A year of the river towns' grain, Commander. I know where every sack of it was taken from.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The caravan has slipped away, Commander. It will be behind the walls by dawn.

lines.speaker: Captain Meryt
lines.text: Nekhet's tribute caravan, Commander, watering at the last oasis before the river. By tomorrow it will be behind his walls.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Bowmen in the palms and riders on the sand. Take the master's tents before they can strike camp, Varius.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We have the caravan master, Commander, and his ledgers with him.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The caravan's outriders are back, Commander. East, coming fast!

levels.name: The Sealed Tomb
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Tomb Wardens
levels.objectiveText: Reach the burial vault within sixteen turns, or eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Reach the burial vault within sixteen turns, or eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Captain Meryt
victoryLines.text: She will keep what she was buried with. The river towns will remember who saw to it, Commander.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The vault is stripped, Commander. They have carried it all away.

lines.speaker: Captain Meryt
lines.text: The tomb of a queen older than the temple, Commander. Nekhet's wardens are carrying her grave goods out to pay his soldiers.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: One priest, his beasts, and a wall. Reach the vault before it is empty, Varius, or leave nobody to carry anything.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We are in the vault, Commander. The seals on the inner chamber are still whole.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Wardens in the valley mouth behind us, Commander, and one of those beasts with them!

levels.name: The Black Sand Landing
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Matahi's Canoes
levels.objectiveText: Land on the beach and break the Toa who hold it. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Land on the beach and break the Toa who hold it. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The beach is ours, Commander. The Toa have gone back into the palms.

victoryLines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
victoryLines.text: Not all of them. Some stayed to look at men who can take that first thrust and stand. They would rather fight beside such men than against them.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They have driven us back into the surf, Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We are ashore, Commander. Black sand, two lagoons, and a village behind the palms.

lines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
lines.text: Those are Matahi's Toa in the water. Watch how they walk through it. The lagoon is a road to them, and a bog to you.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Spearmen who strike hardest at a fresh foe, Varius. Let them spend that first thrust on our shields, not on our archers.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: More of them round the lagoons, Commander! Both flanks!

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: Back into the sea with them! The elder has spoken!

levels.name: The Reef Crossing
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Matahi's Canoes
levels.objectiveText: Cross the reef to the inner island. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Cross the reef to the inner island. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: We are across, Commander, and the far shore is ours.

victoryLines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
victoryLines.text: One of the hawks has come down among your horse-boys and will not leave them. A hawk chooses its rider, Commander, not the other way. I would let it.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We cannot cross under those birds, Commander. The reef is theirs.

lines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
lines.text: The reef, Commander. Knee-deep at this tide from here to the inner island, and no other way across.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Something big is turning over the far shore. Birds, with men on them.

lines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
lines.text: Tahuanui. Sea-hawks, and the boys who are light enough to ride them. They do not trouble shield-men. They stoop on bowmen, and priests, and anything on wheels.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Then our archers cross in the middle of the line, Varius, with spears either side of them.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Hawks behind us, Commander! They have come round over the water!

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: The elder's own guard! Hold the shore until they are among them!

levels.name: The Hill of Spirits
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Matahi's Canoes
levels.objectiveText: Storm the hilltop village and defeat Elder Matahi.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Storm the hilltop village and defeat Elder Matahi.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The elder is dead, Commander. The Toa have grounded their spears, and the thing in the lagoon has gone back under.

victoryLines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
victoryLines.text: The young keepers have asked to sail with you. They say the words should travel, now that the man who kept them here is gone.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The islands will send the Emperor their canoes after this, Varius, and no reaver will ever find a harbour here again.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The hill has thrown us back, Commander. The fence still stands.

lines.speaker: Elder Matahi
lines.text: You have walked a long way over my reef to stand on ground that is tapu, stranger.

lines.speaker: Elder Matahi
lines.text: My fathers sleep in this hill, and the guardian of these waters has heard them wake. Go back to your ships while the lagoon still lets you.

lines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
lines.text: He means the Taniwha, Commander. Stay off the water's edge. It swims the deep where no man can stand, and it strikes hardest from the water.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: The old man mends his warriors as fast as we cut them, Varius. Kill him and the rest is only a fence.

lines.speaker: Elder Matahi
lines.text: Then the hill has chosen... Kahu, see that they tread softly here...

lines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
lines.text: I will, uncle. Toa of Moananui! The elder is gone to his fathers. Put up your spears.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The lagoon, Commander! Something is coming up out of it, on both sides of us!

lines.speaker: Elder Matahi
lines.text: Rise, sons of the canoe! The ancestors are watching you!

levels.name: The Canoe Fleet
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Canoe Guard
levels.objectiveText: Reach the war canoes on the beach within fourteen turns, or eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Reach the war canoes on the beach within fourteen turns, or eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
victoryLines.text: They will build more. But it takes a year to build a war canoe, Commander, and a year is a long peace here.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We never reached the hulls, Commander. The fleet will sail.

lines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
lines.text: Matahi's war canoes, Commander, hauled up above the tide. While they float, no fishing village on these islands sleeps.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Reach the hulls with torches before the crews come down from the gardens, Varius. Fourteen turns of the glass, no more.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The canoes are burning, Commander. Every one of them.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The crews are back from the gardens, Commander. Both ends of the beach!

levels.name: The Taniwha's Pool
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Guardians of the Deep
levels.objectiveText: Hunt the guardians of the lagoon. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Hunt the guardians of the lagoon. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
victoryLines.text: The lagoon is quiet. I will have a stone set here, Commander, so the next keeper knows what woke them.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They have dragged half the line under, Commander. We are pulling back.

lines.speaker: Kahu the Navigator
lines.text: The guardians' pool, Commander. With Matahi gone there is nobody to speak to them, and they have started taking fishermen.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Three of them in the deep, and their keepers on the sandbars. Make them come to us on dry ground, Varius. In the water they are worth two.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Another one, Commander! It was under us the whole time!

levels.name: The Cloud Forest
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs The Serpent Order
levels.objectiveText: Force the forest road into the highlands. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Force the forest road into the highlands. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The road is open, Commander. The snake-skins have gone back up the mountain.

victoryLines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victoryLines.text: My jaguars watched them fight, and two have asked the order's leave to take the serpent's skin. I have given it. A man should know his enemy's poison.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We cannot hold the road, Commander. The forest is full of them.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: The cloud forest, Commander. Up here the trees never dry, and the serpent order has kept this road since before my grandfather's grandfather.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Men in snake-skins at the barricade, and more in the trees. Their blades are black glass, and wet.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: Wet with venom. A cut from a Coatecpatl goes on killing for three days, or for three turns of your glass. Do not trade scratches with them.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Then we kill them quickly or not at all, Varius. Priests behind the line, and nobody fights wounded.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: They are in the trees behind us, Commander! Both sides of the road!

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: The serpent does not let go, stranger! Close the road behind them!

levels.name: The Lake Causeway
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs The Serpent Order
levels.objectiveText: Cross the causeway over the highland lake. Eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Cross the causeway over the highland lake. Eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: We hold both ends of the causeway, Commander. The lake has gone still.

victoryLines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victoryLines.text: One of the water-dogs has followed your leech-keepers back to camp and is eating out of their hands. I cannot explain it. Perhaps it only wanted feeding.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They have pulled the column apart, Commander. We are back on the near shore.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: The lake of Coatlan, Commander. The temple is on the far shore, and the causeway is the only dry way to it.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: There are fords at either end, but something keeps breaking the surface beside the stones.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: Ahuizotl. Water-dogs, with a hand where the tail should end. What one bites, it holds, and a man who is held cannot lift his sword.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: They will come over the side at whoever is in the middle of that causeway, Varius. Cross in a column that can fight to both flanks.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Out of the water, Commander! They are climbing the causeway on both sides!

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: Feed the lake! Drive them off the stones!

levels.name: The Temple of Stars
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs The Star Temple
levels.objectiveText: Storm the star-temple by night and destroy Itzpapal.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Storm the star-temple by night and destroy Itzpapal.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The thing on the altar is gone, Commander. It went out like a lamp.

victoryLines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victoryLines.text: The captain of the shorn ones lives, and he has cut his banner from its pole and laid it at your feet. He kept his oath. He never stepped back. Take him, Commander. There are few like him.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The hill villages will send their tithe again, Varius, and this time nobody will be sending heads back with it.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: The gate held, Commander, and it is nearly dawn. We must fall back.

lines.speaker: Itzpapal the Star-Eater
lines.text: The little captain has brought the sun-killers to my door. Good. I have been hungry since the last eclipse.

lines.speaker: Itzpapal the Star-Eater
lines.text: Come in, come in. Everything that burns in you, I will drink, and be the brighter for it.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: That is Itzpapal, Commander. A star that fell and was fed. Whatever its fire takes from your men, it keeps. Starve it: strike it hard and all at once.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: And mind the shorn ones under the banner, Varius. Men who stand beside a Cuahchic strike before they are struck.

lines.speaker: Itzpapal the Star-Eater
lines.text: Dark... it is so dark down here...

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: Shorn ones! Your star is out. There is nothing left on that altar to die for.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Jaguars out of the trees on both flanks, Commander!

lines.speaker: Itzpapal the Star-Eater
lines.text: Another star for the altar! Wake, little sister, and eat!

levels.name: The Skull Rack
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs Court Guard
levels.objectiveText: Reach the skull rack in the temple court within fourteen turns, or eliminate all enemies.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Reach the skull rack in the temple court within fourteen turns, or eliminate all enemies.

victoryLines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
victoryLines.text: My own father's brother was on that rack, Commander. I will see him buried now.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: We did not reach the court, Commander. The guard is fully roused.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: The serpent order's court, Commander. The rack in the middle holds the heads of every envoy the lowlands ever sent up here.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Pull it down before the temple guard can muster, Varius, and the hill villages will know the order is finished. Fourteen turns.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The rack is down, Commander. The court is ours.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The temple guard, Commander. Out of the east wood!

levels.name: The Drowned Village
levels.subtitle: Carrone Army vs The Lake
levels.objectiveText: Hold the fishing village for 8 turns against the lake.

factions.name: Carrone Army
factions.objective: Hold the fishing village for 8 turns against the lake.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Dawn, Commander. The fence held, and the fishers are already mending their nets.

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer
defeatLines.text: They are inside the fence, Commander. The village is lost.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The fishers have let us inside their fence, Commander. They say the lake comes for the village every dark of the moon.

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: The water-dogs. With the star-temple silent there is nobody to feed them, and they are coming ashore to feed themselves.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Eight turns of the glass until first light, Varius. Keep the fence, and keep the men who are bitten out of the front rank.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: More of them out of the shallows, Commander!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Snake-skins at the south gate, Commander. They have come down to watch us drown.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The whole lake is moving, Commander!

lines.speaker: Eagle Captain Cuali
lines.text: First light, Commander. They will not come out of the water in the sun.
